# FAQ & troubleshooting

### Do I need experimental toggles?
No. Everything uses stable APIs. You need Minecraft Bedrock 1.21.90 or newer.

### Minecraft says the pack is already installed / the old version keeps loading
Delete the old *Black Clover: Grimoire Awakening* packs (Settings → Storage), then import the new `.mcaddon`. Private test builds before the public release used higher internal version numbers than v0.2.0.

### Does it work in multiplayer and on Realms?
It is designed for it: every player has their own grimoire, fruit, Will, stars and hired knights, saved per player. World events pick a random player. Realms accept behavior packs with stable scripts.

### Can I turn off the random events?
Yes - use a War Table and switch "World events" off. Faction offensives stop too.

### My knights / battle soldiers disappeared
War Table soldiers march off 10 s after a battle ends. Wild knights despawn like other mobs when far away; hired knights stay and follow you (and teleport to you when more than 24 blocks away, unless ordered to hold).

### A knight is attacking me
Peaceful NPCs only fight players who hit them; the grudge lasts 30 seconds.

### The Stone Colossus is stuck
It is huge (about 6 blocks tall). Fight it on open ground. It still slams and throws boulders while stuck.

### Spell trails look white
Some devices may not pass colours to the new mana-bolt trails. The bolts themselves keep their colour.

### How do I report a bug or a balance problem?
Open an issue on GitHub and pick the bug or balance template. Include your Minecraft version, the addon version (v0.2.0) and what you were doing.

### My companion disappeared
Companions that fall return after 60 seconds; dismissed ones wait until you summon them from the Companion Whistle. If one is far away (48+ blocks or another dimension) it catches up. Your party is saved with your player, so it is still there after you leave and come back.

### Is this official?
No. It is an unofficial fan-made addon. All models, textures, particles, sounds and icons are original and generated from code; the pirate-themed content is original too.
